meta.title: May's Homework Website
meta.textType: story: teacher feedback and written instructions

paragraphs: After school, May sits at the computer in the white house. Her homework is on the class website. Pat comes in with his toy robot. "What are you doing, May?" he asks. "I do my homework," says May. "Teacher Kim puts a short text here." Above the text, there are two lines in green. They say: "Read the text. Answer the questions below." May reads the text about a small frog. She likes frogs, and she likes English.

Question one is easy. May writes her answer quickly. Question two is difficult. "Where does the frog live?" asks May. She thinks for a long time. She writes: "in a tree." Then a message comes below her answer. It says: "Good try, May. Read sentence three again." Pat looks at the computer, too. "Look, May!" he says.

"The frog is in the water, not in a tree." "Yes!" says May. "Thank you, Pat. You are a good helper." She writes a new answer. Then Teacher Kim writes a new message: "Well done, May!" Mom brings two glasses of juice. "Take a break," she says. Pat points at the computer. "Can I write a message for Teacher Kim?" May smiles and writes: "Hello, Teacher Kim. I am Pat."
text.summary: May does her homework on the class website. Pat helps her, and Teacher Kim sends a nice message.
